testsuite.name: com.linecorp.cse.reqshield.kotlin.coroutine.KeyLocalLockTest

testcase.name: should prevent concurrent lock acquisition after over-release attempt()
should not let a stale token release the lock of the next owner()
should not over-release semaphore on multiple unlock calls()
should share global lockMap across multiple instances()
at the cap tryLock still grants a permit but stops adding map entries()
should maintain request collapsing across multiple instances()
should reject an unlock presenting a token of another owner()
an entry already in the map is reacquired even when the map is at its cap()
should handle high contention tryLock and unLock without over-release()
should not over-release when tryLock and unLock race on expired lock()
unLock removes the map entry right away instead of leaving it until expiry()
